premises.text: College students struggle to get on-demand help, find study groups, and share knowledge, which widens the achievement gap
premises.evidence_span: It's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups if students cannot easily share knowledge or resources

premises.text: School-email signup connects students to classmates and course pages for collaborative study guides and free shared resources
premises.evidence_span: any student can easily access the brainpower and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform

premises.text: Growth relies on a campus founder program, first-day-of-class marketing push, then student-to-student invites
premises.evidence_span: we put together a campus founder program, and we do a big marketing and social media push the first day of class. After that, it's the students inviting their classmates

premises.text: Peer Mentor Program offers scalable, affordable, highly targeted one-on-one online tutoring using platform student and subject signals
premises.evidence_span: we decided to make it highly scalable, affordable, and highly targeted. And we call it the Peer Mentor Program

value.text: Give every college student personalized one-on-one help right when they need it
value.evidence_span: a way for every single college student to get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it

secondary_value.text: Let peer mentors earn money while helping classmates
secondary_value.evidence_span: a way for students to make some money for college
